title: That Day, That Moment, Chanko Nabe

text_block_list.name: Hishi Akebono
text_block_list.text: Here you go, canned mackerel seasoned rice, all done☆

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text: While waiting for the morning bus, Hishi Akebono had pulled out a portable camping stove and mess tin, whipping up a delicious batch of seasoned rice.

text_block_list.name: Hishi Akebono
text_block_list.text:
Smells so good~! Looks like it turned out great~.
There's plenty more where that came from, so eat as much as you like, Trainer♪

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
The warm, gently seasoned rice soothed my exhausted body.
First on the deserted island, and now here—to cook this well with such limited supplies...

text_block_list.name: Hishi Akebono
text_block_list.text: Ehehe~, thank you☆

text_block_list.name: Hishi Akebono
text_block_list.text:
My mom and dad taught me all sorts of things ever since I was little~.
Both of them are super good cooks~.

text_block_list.name: Hishi Akebono
text_block_list.text: Their hot pots and soups are packed with rich, sweet dashi, and their hamburger steaks and fried chicken are crazy juicy.

text_block_list.name: Hishi Akebono
text_block_list.text:
Whenever people eat their cooking, everyone ends up smiling from ear to ear.
Isn't that just wonderful~?

text_block_list.name: Hishi Akebono
text_block_list.text:
That's why I want to be an Umamusume who makes everyone smile,
just like the food my mom and dad make~.

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text: A question suddenly crossed my mind. If that was the case, why did Hishi Akebono choose racing over becoming a professional chef?
choice_data_list: Did you ever think about becoming a chef?
You didn't want to pursue cooking professionally?

text_block_list.name: Hishi Akebono
text_block_list.text: Huh?

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text: If her goal was to bring joy through cooking like her parents, going to culinary school would have made far more sense than Tracen Academy. When I asked her—

text_block_list.name: Hishi Akebono
text_block_list.text: Well, you see... ummm, how should I put it...

text_block_list.name: Hishi Akebono
text_block_list.text: Back then, I actually wanted to *become* chanko nabe!

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text: Bewildered by the bizarre statement, I asked her to elaborate—

text_block_list.name: Interviewer
text_block_list.text:
"Now, following the matches, we present a special segment on sumo stable chanko nabe.
Joining us in the studio are former wrestlers who are now chefs."

text_block_list.name: Former Sumo Wrestler
text_block_list.text:
"—Sumo wrestlers eat chanko nabe together every single day.
That's how they fill their bellies, build up their strength, and grow powerful."

text_block_list.name: Former Sumo Wrestler
text_block_list.text:
"Especially after clashing with everything on the line, gathering around a pot of chanko with your peers is something special.
It satisfies heart and body, brings a smile to your face, and makes you ready to give it your all again."

text_block_list.name: Young Hishi Akebono
text_block_list.text:
Amaaazing! Chanko nabe is so amazing!
Sumo wrestlers are incredible because chanko nabe is incredible~!

text_block_list.name: Young Hishi Akebono
text_block_list.text:
I wanna be chanko nabe too! I'll become chanko nabe,
eat chanko nabe with everyone, and help everyone give it their best all over again!

text_block_list.name: Young Hishi Akebono
text_block_list.text:
—Wait, huh? But if *I* become chanko nabe,
then I won't get to eat chanko nabe...?

text_block_list.name: Hishi Akebono
text_block_list.text: So yeah, I gave up on turning into chanko nabe~.

text_block_list.name: Hishi Akebono
text_block_list.text:
Even so, I couldn't give up on being like 'chanko nabe' without literally being one. So I read books, created recipes...
And then one day, while watching sumo on TV like always—

text_block_list.name: Hishi Akebono
text_block_list.text: And then one day, while watching sumo on TV like always—

text_block_list.name: Sumo Wrestler
text_block_list.text:
"—Man, he was tough. I'm still nowhere near ready to match him.
Still... I gave it everything I had!"

text_block_list.name: Young Hishi Akebono
text_block_list.text:
Mommy, that wrestler lost and was crying just a minute ago,
so why is he smiling now~?

text_block_list.name: Hishi Akebono's Mother
text_block_list.text:
Well, you see...
I'm sure it's because he fought a match he could be truly satisfied with~.

text_block_list.name: Young Hishi Akebono
text_block_list.text: A satisfying match?

text_block_list.name: Hishi Akebono's Mother
text_block_list.text:
It means clashing with all your might so that you feel fully satisfied.
Your opponent has to be giving it their all too, which is surprisingly hard to come by.

text_block_list.name: Hishi Akebono's Mother
text_block_list.text: That's why they feel happy from the bottom of their heart. Truly.

text_block_list.name: Young Hishi Akebono
text_block_list.text:
I see... Feeling satisfied and happy inside.
That sounds... just like when you eat chanko nabe!

text_block_list.name: Hishi Akebono's Mother
text_block_list.text: ...Huh?

text_block_list.name: Hishi Akebono
text_block_list.text:
So, I thought that if I could race someone with all my might,
maybe I could become like "chanko nabe" too~

text_block_list.name: Hishi Akebono
text_block_list.text:
An umamusume that opponents can clash against with everything they've got!
A presence that leaves everyone satisfied and smiling, win or lose!

text_block_list.name: Hishi Akebono
text_block_list.text: I came to Tracen Academy because I wanted to be like that~

text_block_list.name: Hishi Akebono
text_block_list.text: Surprised, weren't you? Hehe, I surprised myself too!

text_block_list.name: Hishi Akebono
text_block_list.text:
It felt like the first time I put it into words properly~ I always knew
racing was fun because it made everyone smile, but...

text_block_list.name: Hishi Akebono
text_block_list.text: To think that's what I was thinking about while running~ Ahaha~!

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
Her sensibility was peculiar in many ways,
but I felt like I had caught a glimpse of her true essence.

text_block_list.name: Hishi Akebono
text_block_list.text:
Whew~ We're finally back at the academy~.
Thanks for all your hard work, Trainer.

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
It was past 8:00 AM by the time we arrived. My body ached all over
from a rough night without proper sleep, but strangely enough, I felt little mental fatigue.
choice_data_list: (Maybe her boundless energy rubbed off on me...)

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
Hishi Akebono looked as fresh and lively as if she hadn't just spent the night outdoors.
She had the bright, refreshed air of someone who'd just enjoyed a sound night's sleep.

text_block_list.name: Hishi Akebono
text_block_list.text:
I've got a mock race today,
so make sure you take it easy and get some good rest, okay~?

text_block_list.name: Hishi Akebono
text_block_list.text: Yup! Huh? Didn't I mention it~?
